name: DIG 💛
desc:
👑Roblox's newest digging and exploration experience!👑

Grab a shovel and step in to the world of DIG! Uncover and collect hidden treasures, explore a massive open world, build unique loadouts with powerful charms, and embark on the journey of a lifetime. 

=====================

[HOW TO DIG]
- Hold out your shovel and click to start digging
- A colored weak spot will appear; try to click when the moving line is in the center of that spot! Don’t worry if you miss- just keep trying!
- Keep trying to hit the weak spot, but watch your endurance bar on the bottom of your screen! If it reaches zero, you may lose your treasure!
- When your progress bar on the left empties; you'll dig up your loot!

=====================

Created by @WoozyNate, @LiamGame09, and @kylecat11!
Music by AZALI00013, DM DOKURO, Heart Plus Up!, APM Music, and M4Gi // MAGI MAGI GO!!

scripts.title: New
scripts.features:
--[ DIGGING & FARMING ]--
• Auto Dig: Automatically completes the digging mini-game with three selectable modes:
• Legit: Simulates normal clicks for maximum safety.
• Blatant: Instantly moves the bar for high speed.
• Instant: Skips the mini-game entirely for peak efficiency.
• Auto Activate Shovel: Automatically starts the next dig after one is finished, ensuring continuous farming.
• Auto Equip Shovel: Automatically equips a shovel from your backpack if your hands are empty.
• Infinite Dig Spot: Allows you to dig in the same spot repeatedly without creating a permanent crater.
• Auto Farm Safe Mode: Slightly moves your character after digging.

--[ PLAYER & INVENTORY ]--
• Sell All Items: A button to instantly sell all items in your inventory at the shop.
• Auto Sell: A toggle to automatically sell all your items at a set interval.
• Claim All Journals: Instantly claims all available journal rewards with a single click.

--[ TELEPORT ]--
• Teleport to Events: Instantly teleports you to special events like the Enchantment Altar, Traveling Merchant, or a Meteor.
• Teleport to Places: Teleport to any discovered spawn location in the game world.
• Teleport to Bosses: Jump directly to any boss location for quick farming.
• Teleport to NPCs: Instantly travel to any NPC on the map.

--[ QUESTS ]--
• Auto Pizza Quest: Fully automates the Pizza Penguin delivery quest, including accepting the quest, delivering the pizza, and completing it. Features smart cooldown detection.

--[ PASSIVE FEATURES (Always Active) ]--
• Built-in Anti-AFK: Keeps you from being disconnected for being idle.
• Stall Detector: A smart system that automatically recovers the script if it gets stuck during long AFK sessions.

--[ CREDITS ]--
• Skedz Hub
